# Are your Dockerfile base images pinned to a digest?

> Paste your Dockerfile and find every FROM line referencing a base image by a mutable tag like node:18 instead of a pinned content digest (@sha256:...). Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
